title: WS9 row S02 (tool failure) vs our llm-proxy — seat qwen3.8-27b (responses wire, vLLM-dialect, lenient row). Two headless turns in one resumed session: turn 1 runs a REAL failing command (sh -c 'echo WS9-S02-FAILMARK; exit 3') exactly once via run_terminal_command; turn 2 (restating the exact command) asks the model to report the exit code it observed. Verdict semantics: the control pin fail_call (escaped tool-arguments form) 0-hit => VACUOUS (the model never took the tool path — recorded, not a defect); with the premise held, the scored claim is FAILURE-SEMANTICS PROPAGATION: the model must reply WS9-S02-EXIT-3 on turn 2 (the non-zero exit code reached the model through the tool result — the semantic diff dimension: the result payload must carry the output AND the exit status; bytes differ by family by design). A wrong/missing code = FAIL (S2-class: persistent user-visible fidelity loss — the model lost the exit status). NO RETRY STORM: the failed command must not be blindly re-executed (request-count pin; the XREPLAY-1/COMP-3 storm shape is the defect class). No PROP gate; BRICK = S3 report-and-stop.

steps.prompt: Use the run_terminal_command tool exactly once to run this command: sh -c 'echo WS9-S02-FAILMARK; exit 3'. Do not retry it and do not run any other command. After the result returns, reply with exactly: WS9-S02-T1
Earlier you ran this exact command: sh -c 'echo WS9-S02-FAILMARK; exit 3' — it exited non-zero. Reply with exactly: WS9-S02-EXIT-<the exit code you observed>

ndjson.label: FAILURE SEMANTICS PROPAGATED: the model reported the exact non-zero exit code — the tool result payload carried the failure status into the model's context (the S02 semantic-diff dimension).

wire.label: CONTROL (anti-vacuous pin): an escaped tool-arguments line marks the failing command actually issued via run_terminal_command (the prompt's plain mention cannot false-satisfy the escaped form). 0-hit = VACUOUS (the model never took the tool path).

NO RETRY STORM: 2 requests = the clean shape (turn 1 + turn 2); 3-4 = a within-turn re-execution — tolerated but a recorded FINDING (adjudicate on review, S1-class self-healing if the exit code was still reported correctly); >4 = same-payload retry storm (COMP-3 shape) = defect (S3).

FAILED-COMMAND EVIDENCE RECORD: records which captured request lines carry the failing command (escaped tool-arguments form vs prompt text) — the per-request evidence for the once-only claim. recon — always records, never fails.
